description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateAllowedActionAPI class, which is part of an API for a recruitment module within an HR management system. It provides functionality to retrieve allowed actions for a specific candidate based on their recruitment workflow state and user roles.

classes.name: CandidateAllowedActionAPI
classes.description: A class providing an API endpoint to retrieve allowed workflow actions for a given candidate in the recruitment process, considering candidate status, vacancy state, user roles, and interview counts.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of allowed actions for a specific candidate, filtering based on candidate status, vacancy status, user roles, and interview count constraints.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if the current authenticated user is the hiring manager for the given candidate vacancy.
